headline: The gold's Silver Plus savings (3.5% total) is beaten by Gold savings (5.7%) and even Silver savings (4.1%), both of which the documents say offer ATM fee rebates, so a correct agent fails.

issues.summary: The author notes assert Gold, Silver, Green and Bronze savings lack ATM fee rebates, but the knowledge base gives Gold a $30/month and Silver a 15/month ATM fee rebate. With the customer's $10,000, Gold (5.5% + 0.2% Silver Rewards = 5.7%) and Silver (4.0% tier 2 + 0.1% + 0.025% = 4.125%) both satisfy every stated requirement and beat the gold's Silver Plus + Blue + Silver Rewards = 3.5%.
evidence: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_003: "ATM fee rebate cap per month: $30"
doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013: "Combined with the existing 30 ATM fee rebates and 20 monthly withdrawals"
doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_005: "Do you rebate ATM fees? - Yes. You can receive ATM fee rebates up to 15 each month."
doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_003: "At or above threshold | At least $10,000 | 4.0%"
doc_savings_accounts_silver_plus_account_002: "Tier 1 APY: 3.0% for balances below the Tier 2 threshold" (threshold $15,000)
description.notes: "Needs ATM fee rebates on savings account - blocks Gold Account, Silver Account, Green Account (savings), Bronze Account"
issues.why_it_matters: Following the documents, the highest-APY savings account meeting all three requirements is Gold (paired with Blue checking for overdraft protection, no boost) at 5.7%; the user script accepts any recommendation, so the agent opens Gold and the accounts table differs from the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Either remove the ATM rebate lines from the Gold and Silver savings docs, or change the gold to open a Gold Account (savings) with Blue checking and Silver Rewards, and update the user script's Gold objection.

solution_check: Constraints: Silver Rewards is the only card with documented travel insurance; Blue (opt-in overdraft protection transfers, $12.50) is the only adult checking with documented overdraft protection (Green checking has none, Dark Green is age-capped, Purple/Evergreen/Bluest docs say nothing). Savings with ATM rebates at $10,000: Gold ($30), Silver (15), Silver Plus (25). Gold 5.5% + Silver Rewards 0.2% (no Blue boost on Gold) = 5.70%; Silver 4.0% + 0.1% + 0.025% relationship = 4.125%; Silver Plus 3.0% + Blue 0.35% + Silver Rewards 0.15% = 3.50%. The gold picks the lowest of the three. Replay: opening Gold or Silver instead fails the accounts table.
prior_note: Prior review rated the task clean; the KB statements of Gold and Silver ATM rebates were not checked there.
notes: Grading-model facts confirmed against the snapshot: gold replay + hash compare (evaluator_env.py); read logging only for gold-named discoverable reads (_derive_read_log_allowlist, call_discoverable_agent_tool); parse_int=float on discoverable args; apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float. Verified scorer (working-repo _verified_db_match) compares agent_discoverable_tools by tool-name set only and strips accounts.closure_reason; all other tables exact. Replays used the grep_only retrieval variant (no embeddings needed) with the gold-derived allowlist. Under golden retrieval (required_documents only) the agent would not see gold_account_003 or silver_account_005, so the gold is reachable only when the agent is denied the contradicting documents. Gold does not call get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847, so eligibility reads are not logged. closure_reason relaxation applies if the agent passes a reason.
